children: Alcoa reported third-quarter 2026 results with third-party revenue of $3.704 billion and net income attributable to Alcoa of $483 million (diluted EPS $1.81). Adjusted net income was $485 million, or adjusted diluted EPS of $1.82, and adjusted EBITDA excluding special items totaled $789 million. The company generated $643 million in cash from operations and $472 million of free cash flow in the quarter.
Revenue: Third-party revenue of $3,704 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Net income attributable to Alcoa: $483 million (diluted EPS $1.81) for 3Q26.
Adjusted net income: $485 million, adjusted diluted EPS of $1.82 for 3Q26.
Adjusted EBITDA excluding special items: $789 million for 3Q26.
Cash flow and liquidity: Cash provided from operations of $643 million; free cash flow of $472 million; cash and cash equivalents of $4,408 million at September 30, 2026.
Production momentum: Aluminum production increased for the sixth consecutive quarter, with year-to-date production records at five smelters and one refinery; Alumar smelter restart completed in 3Q26.

Alumina segment performance: Alumina production rose 11% sequentially to 2.5 million metric tons driven by improved stability at the Pinjarra refinery; third-party alumina shipments increased sequentially.

Aluminum segment activity: Aluminum production increased 2% sequentially to 649,000 metric tons after capacity restarts and the Alumar restart; shipments decreased sequentially following elevated prior-quarter repositioning.

Strategic portfolio actions: Advanced acquisition of AliGroup (South32 shareholder approval received Oct. 15, 2026) and completed debt offerings to fund the transaction; entered definitive sale agreements for portions of the Massena East site with potential proceeds up to $315 million.

Operational outlook: Company reaffirmed full-year 2026 production and shipment ranges for both Alumina and Aluminum segments and expects higher production and shipments in both segments in 4Q26, with segment-specific Adjusted EBITDA guidance noting stability for Alumina and headwinds for Aluminum from higher raw material costs and planned maintenance (~$30 million sequential impact).
